# Sandane Homes
> Premium Serviced Apartments & Stays in Gurgaon (Gurugram), Greater Noida, and Noida.

## About Us
Sandane Homes provides luxury serviced apartments, villas, and premium corporate expat accommodations. We blend the comforts of a home with the professional hospitality of a hotel.

- Short-Stay & Serviced Residences
- Luxury Serviced Apartments for Long Stays
- Corporate Housing & Expat Relocations
- Pet-Friendly Stays
- Multi-cuisine In-House Dining & Gourmet Catering
- Secure On-Site Parking & Free Wi-Fi

## Residences by Sandane Homes — what we offer
Entire furnished 3–4 BHK homes (never rooms) leased by the month, minimum 30 days, to companies for their expat employees, families and project teams, and to individuals. One monthly amount covers the home, daily housekeeping, Wi-Fi, utilities, power backup and maintenance; no broker fees; GST invoice to the company. No prices are published; quotes depend on home, dates and services.
- Long stay serviced apartments in Gurgaon: https://www.sandanehomes.com/long-stay-serviced-apartments-gurgaon

## Common questions (short answers)
- Is Residences by Sandane Homes a hotel? No. It leases entire furnished 3–4 BHK homes by the month. Sandane Homes runs its boutique hotels separately, in Greater Noida, for short stays.
- Where are the Gurgaon homes? Green Meadows and Sushant Lok Block B in Sector 27 (about 10–12 minutes by car to DLF Cyber City), and Conscient Hines Elevate in Sector 58 on Golf Course Extension Road.
- Where are the Greater Noida homes? In Jaypee Greens, Ansal Golf Links and Godrej Golf Link; 3–4 BHK villas and apartments of 2,700–3,500 sq ft.
- Minimum stay? 30 days, up to multi-year postings.
- What is included? Furnished home, daily housekeeping (linen changed twice a week), 300 Mbps Wi-Fi, electricity, water, 100% power backup, society maintenance and repairs. Korean and Japanese breakfast and dinner, and a car to the office, can be arranged.
- How do companies pay? One monthly GST invoice to the company; the employee pays no rent, deposit or broker.
